name: wt
description: Parallel work in git worktrees: out-of-repo worktree hooks, copy-on-write provisioning, a contention-free TODO claim command, a secret-scanning PR command, a fan-out code review that verifies findings adversarially, writes its own edge-case tests and keeps a trickster attacking the premise of the change itself, a 200-line budget on convention docs, and an integration branch that rebuilds staging as the composite of every open pull request.
